catalog.title: CLAUSE DIFF LAB
catalog.desc: Test bench for clause-level diffing: paste/load an Original + Final contract, see the captured records and a redline reconstruction of each clause vs the original. Stores locally in IDB. Admin-only.
catalog.hoverTip: Diff a final contract vs the original (admin test)
catalog.action: if (window.eli && window.eli.dispatch) window.eli.dispatch('tile', 'app_clause_diff_lab'); else if (typeof showClauseDiffLab === 'function') showClauseDiffLab(window.eli); else if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('Clause Diff Lab not loaded.', 'error');
